findings: Two authorities: privileged legacy Reality versus independent profiles
Credential count, routing classes and protocol immutable after creation
No profile DELETE lifecycle; disable only hides output
Network-switch form retains incompatible path (profile_path_invalid in video)
Native write confirmation is coupled to traffic proof; need separate persisted stages
Profile health counts omit actual publication eligibility
Legacy manual maintenance and transport history remain in Configs
Removed extra ten-minute enrolment exclusion; status and controller now share identical eligibility
design: One desired profile and controller for every protocol; per-profile revision, credentials and port ownership
Automatic create/update/resize/delete with native observation before retry; no blind POST replay
Confirm native changes independently from traffic verification; retain fresh output fences
Pause/delete/scope removal retire only the owned listener; siblings remain unchanged
One-time durable reset retires prior configs and closes legacy creation permanently; cleanup per panel releases that panel independently
One simple card per profile, exact publication counts and understandable per-server retry state
